text_block_list.text:
We were planning a strategy for Seiun Sky's
next race, but...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
So, about our next strategy...
How does "Operation Cotton Candy" sound?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Look, gaze upon those pure white clouds
floating in that blue sky...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"It's super fluffy just like cotton candy!
Doesn't it look delicious?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Handing out cotton candy to everyone before the race,
getting into the festival spirit and shouting 'wasshoi' together...
...Yeah, no good.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "Sei-chan's head is the one that's completely blank and fluffy..."

"Seiun Sky seems to have built up quite a lot of fatigue, and her thoughts are all scattered.
It looks like we'll need to reconsider her upcoming race schedule."
